messages:
linus: Quick intake — bringing up Meridian-13B for serving. Need a short triage: baseline perf, quant plan (int8 / fp8 / gguf), and any known eval risks. ETA for smoke runs?

alice: +1. Can we get a baseline generate/embedding eval on 1k prompts first? want latency and quality anchors before quant.

jamie: I can run the smoke quant matrix today. plan: gguf (fp16), int8, fp8 (if supported). will do 100 samples each for ppl/bleu/conv-quality. need dataset and seed.

rachel: Heads up — last 13B we onboarded had a subtle coherency drop at long contexts after int8. watch long-seq tests (8k). Also watch hallucination rate on KB tasks.

sam: Allocating a slot now. quick command i'll use:
```
redwood-cli models upload --name meridian-13b --format gguf --path ./meridian/gguf/meridian-13b.gguf
redwood-cli eval run --model meridian-13b --suite quick-smoke --samples 100 --out results/json
```
If you want int8 probe, i'll convert with `rvq convert --to int8 --calib 500` then run same eval.

linus: Dataset: use `onboard/quick-1k.jsonl` (diverse mix: prompts, kb, instruction, conv). Long-seq set: `onboard/long-200.jsonl` for 4k+ tokens. Seed: 42.

jamie: noted. i'll also add the `sensitivity` probe (vary temp 0.2/0.7) and record token-level latency.

quant-bot: Calibration job queued: job_id=cal-3170001140. 500 calibration samples, per-layer histogram enabled. I will post results when done. :robot_face:

ops-bot: GPU pool allocated: p4d-8x for 2 hours (claim: jamie). mounting /mnt/models/meridian.

alice: Checklist for bring-up (short):
- run baseline eval (unquantized) ✅
- run gguf (fp16) quick smoke ✅
- int8 calibration + eval (500 calib) -> metric delta table
- fp8 probe if building supports it -> compare cost/quality
- long-context coherency tests (8k)
- hallucination/regression sweep on KB tasks
- perf counters + latency p50/p95
- rollouts: canary 1% then 10% with fallback to previous model

rachel: For quality thresholds, propose: perplexity delta <= 2% and KB exact-match drop <= 1.5% for int8; if above, fallback plan. We'll have stricter for fp8 (<=1%).

sam: Starting int8 convert now. running calibrate: `rvq calibrate --model meridian-13b --samples 500 --out calib/int8.json`

jamie: FYI, mixing gguf + int8 experiments will live in `/experiments/meridian/2026-03-20`. i'll post aggregated CSV.

quant-bot: Calibration complete: job_id=cal-3170001140. Summary: max per-layer quant error 0.9%, avg 0.2%. Uploading calib artifact to s3://redwood-quant/meridian/3170001140/int8-calib.json

linus: Nice. jamie — can you run eval on calibrated int8 artifact and post CSV with columns: metric, baseline, int8, delta_pct, cost_estimate_tok?

jamie: on it. will also add p50/p95 latency and token throughput.

alice: If int8 delta > thresholds, try hybrid-int8 for attention + fp16 for FFN (fast fallback). Also log any sample-level diffs (store first 20 diffs).

rachel: Also run rerank/embedding cosine checks — embeddings sometimes degrade subtly after quant. keep >0.98 avg cos for the embed probe.

sam: int8 eval started: `redwood-cli eval run --model meridian-13b-int8 --suite onboard/quick-1k --calib-artifact s3://redwood-quant/...`

ops-bot: Notice: quota bump applied to jamie for this window.

jamie: Results posted: `/experiments/meridian/2026-03-20/int8-results.csv` — quick summary in thread: perplexity +1.4%, KB EM -0.8%, embedding cos avg 0.985, latency +8% p95. cost_estimate per token -32%.

linus: Those look within proposed thresholds. Good tradeoff. let's run fp8 probe to compare cost/quality (if fp8 runtime available).

quant-bot: FP8 probe request queued: job_id=fp8-3170001300. Note: fp8 runtime uses different kernels; expect latency variability.

jamie: FP8 results: perplexity +0.6%, KB EM -0.4%, embed cos 0.989, latency +12% p95, cost_est -51%. Quality hit smaller, cost win larger.

alice: Decision: enable int8 by default for non-KB endpoints; offer fp8 as a specialized config for high-throughput needs with caution on latency-sensitive routes. Canary plan: 1% users -> monitor eval regressions + OOMs -> 10% -> full.

rachel: Add monitoring alerts: if KB EM drop >1% or hallucination rate up by >2% -> auto rollback. Also add token-level sampling to S3 for regression triage.

linus: Thanks team. Follow-ups: jamie to draft the canary config and rollout steps; sam to attach conversion scripts; alice to add eval CSVs to the onboarding ticket. Check-in tomorrow 11am PT.

jamie: will do, uploading docs now. :thumbsup:

sam: scripts and notes at `/ops/onboard/meridian/scripts/convert-and-eval.sh`.

linus: closing intake thread — keeping thread open for post-canary notes. good job. :party_parrot:
